name: Takanashi Kiseki
source:
—Control—

A 2nd-year student at Marenis High School.
He has a bright personality, many friends of both genders, and is always in the higher ranks of the class caste.
His specialties are the guitar and general athletics. As for his height, he believes he's still in his growth period.
The heroine is from the same elementary school, and is his first love.
As a child, he had a timid personality.

"Huh? I told you, I'm right in the middle of a growth spurt!"

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=2]official website[/url]]
